Job Description Senior Staff Embedded Software Engineer responsible for hands-on development and technical leadership of real-time, mission-critical embedded software for unmanned aircraft and robotic systems.

This engineer will develop embedded C/C++ software, bring up new hardware platforms from scratch, develop and adapt board support packages (BSPs) and device drivers, and integrate software directly with custom electronics. The engineer must be able to take a newly designed PCB/PCBA, read hardware schematics and component/ASIC datasheets, understand pinouts and interfaces, and bring the system from initial hardware through functioning embedded software.

The role works closely with hardware, systems, test, and software engineering teams throughout the full development lifecycle, including architecture, implementation, hardware/software integration, troubleshooting, system-level testing, and flight testing.

This is a hands-on Senior Staff individual contributor/technical lead role, not a people-management position. The engineer should be capable of independently leading complex technical projects while continuing to code, debug hardware, and solve difficult real-time embedded system problems.

Primarily onsite in Moorpark, CA due to regular access to prototype hardware and lab equipment.
